TI.P: Decision of the EEA Joint Committee
amending Annex XI (Electronic communication, audiovisual services and information society) to the EEA Agreement [2019/751]

GR.VISA.VISA: Having regard to the Agreement on the European Economic Area (the EEA Agreement), and in particular Article 98 thereof,

NP.TXT:
Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2016/1250 of 12 July 2016 pursuant to Directive 95/46/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council on the adequacy of the protection provided by the EU-U.S. Privacy Shield
OJ L 207, 1.8.2016, p. 1. is to be incorporated into the EEA Agreement.
Annex XI to the EEA Agreement should therefore be amended accordingly,

ALINEA.P: The following point is inserted after point 5ep (Commission Implementing Decision 2013/65/EU) of Annex XI to the EEA Agreement:

NP.TXT: 32016 D 12 50: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2016/1250 of 12 July 2016 pursuant to Directive 95/46/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council on the adequacy of the protection provided by the EU-U.S. Privacy Shield (OJ L 207, 1.8.2016, p. 1).

ARTICLE.ALINEA: The text of Implementing Decision (EU) 2016/1250 in the Icelandic and Norwegian languages, to be published in the EEA Supplement to the Official Journal of the European Union, shall be authentic.

This Decision shall enter into force on 8 July 2017, provided that all the notifications under Article 103(1) of the EEA Agreement have been made
No constitutional requirements indicated..
This Decision shall be published in the EEA Section of, and in the EEA Supplement to, the Official Journal of the European Union.
